entries.note: A German Air Force launcher on the RMMV HX 8x8 in German three-tone, side on: the HX cab, the equipment shelter behind it with its two masts, the lower boxes and outrigger legs, the eight canisters raised to vertical on their frame at the rear.

entries.author: Boevaya mashina
entries.note: Left side from slightly ahead, green: the HX cab with its ladder and grilled intake, the shelter with the masts up, the canister frame's elevating ram at the rear.

entries.author: Boevaya mashina
entries.note: Right rear quarter: the canisters in two rows of four, their latch collars, the hinge frame across the rear, the tail lights under it.

entries.author: Boevaya mashina
entries.note: From behind, in desert paint: the canister pack's base, four across and two deep over the whole width, the hinge beam and the rear jacks.

entries.author: Air Command West, Ukrainian Air Force (Повітряне командування "Захід" Повітряних Сил ЗС України)
entries.note: Ukrainian launchers being reloaded: the canister frame lowered flat over the rear deck, canisters craned in lying flat; the shelter and boxes behind the cab.
